KPIs.Name: Emission Reduction
KPIs.Note: Annual metric-ton emission reductions by pollutant from No Build to Build, using the October 2026 emission methodology. Positive values indicate reductions; negative values indicate increases.

Formula.Comment:
Evaluate the same analysis Year for both scenarios. Sources in Scenario Upstream and KPI Preparation are paired by scenarioSlot; base-year tables and factor definitions are shared. Table-field notation is local to each KPI; global field definitions remain unchanged. VehicleGroup and PowerType are iteration variables from global lookup-input domains. DelayReductionProjectType is the existing global domain of Projects.Delay Reduction Projects and the delay-reduction lookup. These are computational domains, not additional output dimensions. County FIPS is read directly from Sub-Regions.FIPS through the existing geography relation. This KPI has no custom sources.

Require valid matched links, positive base/model volumes, positive modeled horizon and travel times, consistent units and valid fleet shares. New/removed links, zero base volumes, unknown county or factor extrapolation require an explicit methodology decision; no silent defaults. Analysis years must also satisfy factor coverage (common window 2023–2045). The BaseYear constant used by KPIs 102 and 103 must match the actual base-year table.

Project is the basic reporting scale. Spatial totals sum whole non-overlapping projects; cross-boundary projects require explicit allocation before aggregation, especially for project-level starts. Do not sum overlapping project benefits.

The user confirmed KPI 99 is annual, avoided starts are regular vehicles, and its count includes both power types. Split with the NoBuild EV ratio; annual starts are not multiplied by 365. KPI 14 retains its established internal identity so existing downstream references remain connected. Energy and monetization methodology changes remain separate tasks.

Electric Vehicle Ratio remains a paired reference to Scenario Info. Scenario Year and the Base Year constant are referenced by KPIs 102 and 103. Bike Ped Growth Rate remains the existing global constant used by KPIs 97 and 98 upstream of annual KPI 99; it is not applied again here.

KPI 102 Any-Year Travel Time Minutes and KPI 103 Any-Year Volume supply the scenario-specific Year/Period/Link values. Select each KPI for both No Build and Build. KPI 14 converts KPI 102 minutes to hours but does not redefine either interpolation.

items.generalExplanation: Union of canonical project link IDs across both scenarios. Each included link requires valid base/model anchors and county membership. New/removed links or zero base volume need an explicitly approved trajectory; do not silently drop them or fabricate zero emissions.

Select the unique county by matching SubRegion ID to the link’s SubRegion IDs and filtering SubRegion Type = County. Read its FIPS field directly from Sub-Regions through the existing Base Highway Links–Sub-Regions relation. Require exactly one county with a populated FIPS code; unknown or ambiguous membership is an error. Match that code to the corresponding county key in the emission-factor tables. No county-name or FIPS lookup is used.
